events.title: UNDERGROUND Festival — Night 1: Casefile Presents & The Unfair Advantage
events.description: The opening night of HOTA's UNDERGROUND Festival features Casefile Presents: Criminal Conversations for a deep-dive into true crime with authors Vikki Petraitis and Emily Webb, alongside magician Harry Milas's performance 'The Unfair Advantage', revealing secrets of illusion and security.

events.title: UNDERGROUND Festival — Night 2: Berlin Art Party, Jlin Live & UNTETHERED
events.description: This night features a 1930s Berlin-themed art party with bohemian spirit, a live electronic music performance by Jlin, and contemporary dance by dynamic collectives. Also includes a free participatory video installation, Paradise Hero.

events.title: UNDERGROUND Festival — HOTMESS Life Drawing
events.description: An immersive and meticulously art-directed life drawing class blended with a hybrid performance, inviting participants to ignite their creative flair through cheeky and evocative themes.

events.title: Bond University: Enterprise AI in Action
events.description: An applied look at how AI is reshaping enterprise operations, ideal for those curious about the practical and ethical dimensions of AI in the real world.

events.title: Bond University: Studying with ADHD — Avoiding Procrastination and Distraction
events.description: A community-style wellbeing and psychology talk exploring focus, cognition, and productivity, specifically addressing challenges related to studying with ADHD.

events.title: Bond University: Auslan Basics in Sign Language
events.description: A hands-on, introductory language class to learn Auslan (Australian Sign Language), offered as a community-oriented workshop open to all.

events.title: Bond University: New National Code — GBV: What You Need to Know
events.description: An informational talk on gender-based violence policy under the new national code, presented as an important and thought-provoking community session.

events.title: Bond University: Architecture Experience Day
events.location: Bond University, Abedian School of Architecture, Robina
events.description: Immerse yourself in design with hands-on activities including Sketch & Design, Model Making, and Fabrication & Robotics Demonstrations, bringing architectural creativity to life.

events.title: Cooly Rocks On Festival
events.description: A five-day festival transporting Coolangatta back in time with classic cars, hot rods, lowbrow art, and rock 'n' roll, swing, and rockabilly music, including an Elvis Tribute Artist contest and Nostalgia Markets.

events.title: HOTA Gallery: Ongoing Exhibitions
events.description: Explore multiple free exhibitions at HOTA Gallery, including the Public Program of Talks & Ideas/Workshops and Ballun Gawrehma: Story by the River, offering a rich arts encounter throughout the week.

events.title: HOTA Gallery Public Program: Talks & Ideas / Workshops
events.description: An ongoing public program featuring intellectually engaging talks, ideas, and workshops, recommended for ages 15+, with rotating themes and participating artists in the HOTA Gallery.

events.title: Gold Coast Jazz and Blues Club Gig
events.description: An intimate jazz evening presented by the Gold Coast Jazz and Blues Club at HOTA, offering a musically rich live event for a thoughtful, mixed-age crowd.

events.title: The Spooky Men's Chorale
events.description: A wonderfully offbeat and culture-rich performance by The Spooky Men's Chorale, an Australian all-male a cappella ensemble known for their deep bass harmonies, humour, and extraordinary live presence.

events.title: Live Nation Gig
events.description: A Live Nation and Jubilee Street Management presented gig at HOTA, recommended for ages 15+. Check the HOTA website for specific artist announcement and details.

events.title: Australian Open Lawn Bowls — Opening Weekend
events.location: Various Gold Coast venues (e.g., Broadbeach greens)
events.description: Experience the vibrant, social community atmosphere of the world's biggest bowls festival, where you can freely spectate elite bowlers, enjoy the winter sun, and easily engage in conversation with strangers.
